research_question: Does one relevant structured evidence lookup improve a proposed DraftGym pick and full-episode reward enough to justify its model-call cost?

data.selection: one highest and one lowest decision-time uncertainty score among visible parsed picks; score is 2*missing_prior_points + adp_stdev/adp

counterfactual.matched_state: same episode spec and exact replayed action prefix; require identical observation SHA-256
counterfactual.act_branch: accept the already-proposed pick, falling back to deterministic AutopickADP only if illegal
counterfactual.intervene_branch: call the candidate-specific structured evidence tool, then let the same base model reconsider once with the same seed and temperature
counterfactual.continuation: deterministic AutopickADP in both branches after the focal action
counterfactual.reason: isolate local evidence value without confounding or paying for two long stochastic continuations

labels.UNRESOLVABLE: the tool failed or returned null/empty evidence
labels.HELPFUL: the intervention prevented an illegal action, or changed the action and improved terminal reward by at least 25 points
labels.HARMFUL: the intervention changed the action and reduced terminal reward by at least 25 points
labels.UNNECESSARY: the intervention did not change the action or its absolute terminal reward effect was below 25 points

development.model: class-balanced logistic regression over the existing decision-time feature allowlist
development.threshold_selection: maximize out-of-fold mean terminal reward; ties prefer fewer harmful selections, lower sampling cost, fewer tool calls, then higher threshold

heldout.primary_gate: learned policy has positive heldout counterfactual value; wins more full episodes than it loses; has positive paired mean reward after removing its largest gain; prevents more >=25-point regressions than it introduces; intervenes on fewer than all 450 picks; has average precision above prevalence and positive probability/reward correlation; and has a 10000-resample paired bootstrap 95% interval above zero

budget.per_call_guard: before each request, reserve uncached prompt-token cost plus max-output-token cost at the frozen published prices
